Application Data.NAME: Stitched Elegance Embroidery
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stitched Elegance Embroidery specializes in high-quality embroidery and custom apparel services. We create personalized garments for individuals, teams, and businesses, focusing on unique designs tailored to our clients' needs. Our operations involve the use of state-of-the-art embroidery machines and heat presses to produce durable and aesthetically pleasing products. We prioritize safety by adhering to strict maintenance protocols and fire safety measures to mitigate risks associated with our machinery.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses reported include a fire incident on 05/15/2022, caused by a heat press malfunction, resulting in damages of $1,800. The claim was filed and is currently closed. Additionally, there was a theft loss on 08/10/2023, where equipment valued at $700 was stolen from the premises. This claim is also closed. Total reported losses amount to $2,500.00.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system monitored by a central station, on-site security personnel during peak hours, and a perimeter fence to deter unauthorized access.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Not Acceptable:
– Businesses offering tattooing, waxing, spa, bodywork, or any form of cosmetic procedures
or enhancements, as these introduce significant liability and regulatory complexities out-
side the scope of a standard BOP.
– Operations involving permanent body modifications or medical-grade cosmetic services.
– Examples include shops combining embroidery with tattoo services or cosmetic piercing,
which require specialized professional liability coverage and are better suited for other
lines of insurance.
Key Risk Considerations
Underwriters should carefully evaluate the following risks inherent
to embroidery and custom apparel businesses:
• Fire Risk from Heat Presses and Equipment: Heat presses, embroidery machines, and
screen printing equipment operate at high temperatures and electrical loads, increasing the
risk of fire. Proper maintenance, use of fire-retardant materials, and installation of smoke
detectors and sprinklers mitigate this risk.
